description: Four-input OR gate with a separate logical inverter, polyphonic; a voltage over 2V counts as high and stays high until it falls below 0.1V

inputs.text: The first of the four inputs into the OR; with nothing patched here the OR output stays at 0V, and the number of channels patched here sets the polyphony
One of the four inputs into the OR; left unpatched it takes the voltage from A instead of counting as low
One of the four inputs into the OR; left unpatched it takes the voltage from B instead of counting as low
One of the four inputs into the OR; left unpatched it takes the voltage from C instead of counting as low
The signal fed to the inverter; with nothing patched here the inverter is fed the OR result instead

outputs.text: 10V while any of the four inputs is high, 0V while all of them are low
The logical inverse of what the inverter is fed: 10V when that is low, 0V when it is high. With the I input empty this is the NOR of the four inputs
